title: Pompeii — what actually happened to the people
style: documentary photograph, Roman Italy, hard Mediterranean light, ash grey and terracotta, fine grain, no text, no watermark, no modern objects
negative: no modern buildings, no tourists, no signage, no cartoon, no illustration

lines.vo: The victims of Pompeii were not killed by falling rock.
lines.title: NOT THE ROCK

lines.vo: The mountain stood five miles from the town, across the bay.
caption: Five miles
of open ground.

lines.vo: Pumice came down on the roofs, grain after grain, hour after hour.
The streets were open, and the road to the coast was still a way out.
A current of hot ash swept down and buried the streets.
caption: Not falling.
FLOWING.

lines.vo: The heat killed them, and it killed them fast.
Ash sealed each body, and the body decayed away.
caption: A hollow
where a person
had been.

lines.vo: Diggers poured plaster into the cavity, and the shape of a person came back.
The famous casts are not people turned to stone.
Pompeii was not destroyed in one instant. It was destroyed in stages.
lines.title: IN STAGES
lines.footer: pumice, then ash, then the current
